accomplishments.statement: Built a local Python prototype for checking 6 importer error cases. The prototype I built was local and was used to check those importer errors, which were 6 error cases in total. It was never deployed to production, did not use SQLite, and had no measured speed improvement.

Completed SQLite retry checks for 30 synthetic queue tasks. What I completed was the retry-checking work on those 30 synthetic tasks, not the whole queue project. The larger queue project remains in progress. This work did not implement the importer and did not use Python.
